translations.web: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
translations.bsb: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
translations.kjv: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
